observations: Two used automatic transmissions sitting on a dirt floor.
Photo 0 shows a large transmission with a '6969' sticker on the side and a '3Y69' sticker on the top.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of a multi-pin electrical connector on the side of the transmission.
The transmissions appear dusty and used, suggesting they are not new.
Watermarks for 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all photos.

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts

claims.evidence: The photos are provided, but the content is not verified.

risks.risk: The transmission may not be in working order or may have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission shifting through all gears or a diagnostic code reading.

risks.risk: The transmission may be a used part from a different vehicle or a different model than the seller claims.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the side or back of the case).

risks.risk: The transmission may have internal leaks or fluid leaks that are not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video of the transmission being filled with fluid or a close-up photo of the fluid reservoir and seals.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the transmission being shifted through all gears to confirm it works.
Photo of the fluid reservoir and seals to check for leaks.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
